answer: Escrowed Work Ledger. Each identity must pre-fund a lotus of escrow that only unlocks after a distinct counterparty confirms delivery, so a clone pays full escrow and earns nothing without genuine trade. Every dune of payoff thus requires a matching unreturned deposit, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV. The lagoon of idle escrow is slashed on failed confirmation, so attackers lose principal per identity rather than gaining leverage.
